# CRAPBUCKET
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Small
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 2-3
[color=#a4885c]Initial Generator Type:[/color] Uranium
A buccaneer-themed raiding vessel with mounted weapons on either side. The internals are of a nice veneer and parquet wood style, but the exterior is well-protected. It is designed for active engagements and theft, sporting little room for cargo hauling.
